A deliberately broken page

Every fault on this page is planted. It exists so the scanner has something to find that does not change underneath it.

5. Text too faint to read

This paragraph is grey on white. It is legible on a good monitor in a dark room, and not legible in sunlight, at a glance, or by a great many people in ordinary conditions.

This paragraph is near-black on white, at about 16.9:1.

6. The one you cannot see

FAULT 6 -- rule: html-has-lang. The page never says what language it is written in, so a screen reader reads English with whatever accent it was last set to. Look at the very first tag of this file: there is no lang attribute to find.

7. The one the scanner misses

The field below has no label element at all. It is named only by the grey word inside it, which vanishes as soon as you type. The scanner reports nothing about it.
